title: Smell receptors sit in a small patch high in the nasal cavity
summary: Olfactory receptor neurons in the olfactory epithelium bind odorant molecules that dissolve in the nasal mucus.
body: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology locates olfactory receptor neurons in the olfactory epithelium, a small region in the superior nasal cavity. Inhaled molecules dissolve in the mucus and bind receptor proteins on the olfactory dendrites. Axons from those neurons reach the olfactory bulb. The chapter is CC BY teaching anatomy, not a smell test.
